The award combines the previous categories for Best Female Country Vocal Performance, Best Male Country Vocal Performance and Best Country Instrumental Performance (if it is an instrumental solo performance).

2. Best Country Solo Performance Grammy Award Winners & Nominees
URL: https://www.grammy.com/awards/categories/best-country-solo-performance/
The Grammy Award for Best Country Solo Performance recognizes excellence in recordings of country music performances by solo artists, both vocal and instrumental. Eligible recordings reflect the broad spectrum of country music style and culture.
